notes.title: DOORKA DEMO v.1.1 version release
notes.content:
[h1]BUGFIXES[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed levels not loading (black screen) for some devices.
[i]Please report through Feedback window (F8) if you still get this problem![/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Level ranks now save correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix doors stuck in some areas. [/p][/*][*][p]Fix persistence of tutorial messages between levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix enemy navigation in level "Door storage".[/p][/*][/list][h1]VISUALS[/h1][list][*][p]Updated some textures.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed lighting settings for better visibility.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing DOORKA![/p]
